meta.title: Source registry
meta.policy: Only the sources below were used. Anything not obtainable from them is left blank and flagged for review, never inferred or filled in.

sources.name: NFL.com official league standings - 2026 regular season
sources.used_for: W-L-T, PF, PA, home/road/div/conf records, streak, last5 for all 32 teams

sources.name: NFL.com official injury report - Week 10, 2026
sources.used_for: Player, position, injury, practice status and game status for the 28 teams playing in Week 10

sources.name: NFL.com official schedule - 2026 Week 10
sources.used_for: 14 games, kickoff times (ET), networks, byes, Thursday final score

sources.name: Ourlads NFL depth charts (printer-friendly, per team)
sources.used_for: Depth ordering (Player 1..5), draft pedigree codes, reserve/IR/PUP lists. NOT used for availability.

sources.name: Ourlads depth chart key / legend
sources.used_for: Decoding symbols: IR, PUP, DFR, CE, CF##, SF##, U/, T/, W/, P/, CC/, ##/R (draft year/round), ^ (IR return eligible)

sources.name: ESPN scoreboard API - 2026-11-12
sources.used_for: Independent cross-check of the Thursday WAS@NYG result and venue

sources.name: NFL.com game page - Commanders at Giants, 2026 Week 10
NFL.com news roundup, Friday Nov 13 2026
sources.used_for: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson expected to miss 6-10 weeks (depth context)

sources.name: NFL.com news - Drew Lock to start for Seahawks vs. Raiders
sources.used_for: Cross-check that Seattle's QB2 replaces the ruled-out starter

sources.name: NFL.com news - Sam Darnold ruled out for Week 10

rejected_or_unavailable.consequence: Depth ordering taken from S04 only

rejected_or_unavailable.result: Not accessible from this environment; no verified odds feed exists in the repo
rejected_or_unavailable.consequence: No market comparison, no closing-line value, no vig-adjusted EV. All models are line ORIGINATION only. Flagged F-03.
One-score-game luck, situational splits and prop-level correlations cannot be computed. Recorded in the questions register.

authority_rules: Game availability (Out / Doubtful / Questionable) comes ONLY from S02. Ourlads O/Q flags in S04 are treated as unverified inputs and every disagreement is logged in the flagged register.
Depth ORDER comes from S04 only.
Draft pedigree comes from S04 codes decoded with S05.
Every number in data/*.json carries a src field pointing at one of these IDs.
